response.sql: WITH total AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS t FROM Order_Items), prod AS (SELECT p.product_id, p.production_type_code, AVG(CAST(oi.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_qty, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS item_cnt, 1.0 * COUNT(oi.order_item_id) / (SELECT t FROM total) AS share FROM Products p LEFT JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.production_type_code), by_type AS (SELECT pc.product_type_description, AVG(prod.avg_qty) AS avg_qty, AVG(prod.item_cnt) AS avg_cnt, AVG(prod.share) AS avg_share FROM prod JOIN Product_Categories pc ON pc.production_type_code = prod.production_type_code GROUP BY pc.product_type_description) SELECT AVG(avg_qty) AS avg_product_quantity, AVG(avg_cnt) AS avg_order_item_count, AVG(avg_share) AS avg_share_of_order_items FROM by_type
